name: m5-lazydepth-sam-paired

variantDescriptions.current: `claude/lazy-lub-depth` (retronym/scala#245): by-name `=> Depth`, memoized with local vars in `solve` and `mergePrefixAndArgs`
variantDescriptions.polish: `claude/lazy-lub-depth-polish` (retronym/scala#246): `LazyDepth` abstract class, call sites SAM-convert `() => lubDepth(...)`

description: Is #246's SAM `LazyDepth` perf-neutral against #245's by-name memo? The two builds emit byte-identical class files. Single-fork kperf spikes disagreed (m5-lazydepth-polish-kperf flat; m5-lazydepth-sam-kperf +3% cycles, +2.5% alloc, with #245's own alloc moving 2% between them), so: both builds' quick classes paired by iteration within each fork, typer only, scala corpus, 4 forks of 40 + 60 single shots, laptop.
